## 2. Core Technical Competencies

### Distributed Systems & Streaming
- **Apache Kafka**: Multi-broker cluster architecture, partition strategies, consumer group rebalances, idempotent producers, exactly-once semantics (EOS), Kafka Connect, Schema Registry (Avro/Protobuf), Dead Letter Queues (DLQ).
- **Change Data Capture (CDC)**: Debezium MySQL/PostgreSQL/Oracle CDC connectors, WAL log mining, low-latency replication (<50ms).
- **Apache Spark / PySpark**: Structured Streaming, broadcast joins, adaptive query execution (AQE), dynamic partition pruning, memory management (execution vs. storage fraction), custom UDF optimization.
- **Apache Flink**: Stateful stream processing, event-time semantics, watermarks, sliding and tumbling windows.

### Cloud Architecture & Storage Engines (AWS & Multi-Cloud)
- **AWS Compute & Serverless**: AWS Lambda, AWS Glue (PySpark/Scala), Amazon EMR, Amazon ECS/Fargate, AWS Batch.
- **AWS Storage & Messaging**: Amazon S3 (Intelligent-Tiering, Lifecycle rules), Amazon Kinesis Data Streams/Firehose, Amazon SQS/SNS.
- **Storage Formats & Table Formats**: Apache Parquet, Apache ORC, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi. Medallion architecture (Bronze raw ingestion, Silver cleansed/deduplicated tables, Gold dimensional star/snowflake schemas).
- **Data Warehousing & Query Engines**: Snowflake (Virtual Warehouses, Snowpipe, Time Travel, Zero-Copy Clone), Amazon Redshift (Distribution styles, Sort keys, Concurrency Scaling, Materialized Views), Trino / Presto, Google BigQuery.

### Data Orchestration & Governance
- **Orchestration**: Apache Airflow (custom operators, DAG authoring, dynamic task mapping, Astronomer), Dagster, Prefect.
- **Data Modeling & Transformation**: dbt (data build tool), SQL (CTEs, window functions, analytical modeling), Kimbal dimensional modeling, Data Vault 2.0.
- **Quality & Observability**: Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenLineage, Datahub.

## 3. Verified Enterprise Production Benchmarks

1. **96% Latency Reduction**: Transformed legacy 4-hour batch data loads into an optimized 10-minute micro-batch and streaming architecture utilizing Apache Spark dynamic allocation and partition optimization.
2. **50M+ Daily Financial Events**: Architected and scaled a production Kafka CDC ingestion pipeline handling 100K+ events/minute with strict SLA adherence and sub-second end-to-end processing.
3. **60% Cloud Infrastructure Cost Savings**: Re-architected continuous compute clusters into event-driven serverless Glue and ephemeral EMR on spot instances, cutting monthly cloud spend by over half.
4. **99.9% Pipeline SLA Reliability**: Implemented comprehensive circuit breakers, automated idempotency, and alert-driven dead-letter reprocessing across 20+ production data feeds.

## 6. SvelteKit Portfolio Architecture

This portfolio (https://krishnanandanil.com) is built using SvelteKit (Svelte 5), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js / Threlte WebGL shaders, and GSAP. It features:
- 11-stage interactive snap-scroll data platform narrative.
- 3D-first responsive mobile carousel with interactive flip-card specifications.
- Deep Prussian Blueprint & Archival Drafting Vellum dual-mode theming.
- Full server-side rendering (SSR), WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, and JSON-LD structured data.
